## 💡 Feature Summary

A brief, clear description of the feature you're proposing.

---

## 🤔 Problem / Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

_Example: "As a user, I find it difficult to find channels in my language because there is no language filter..."_

---

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

---

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or links to similar features in other products.

---

## 📋 Additional Context

Any other context, links, or information about the feature request.

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This feature would benefit the majority of users (not just my personal use case)
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to implementing this feature
